holder-quote: So saying, Zel pointed at the [Guardsmen]. He spoke two words.
effect-quote: They stood taller, and when the snarling Scalelings rammed into them, it was the monsters who fell back.

holder-quote: Briganda threw up her buckler. Revi saw her shield glow—a hail of needles snapped as they hit the barrier. Briganda grunted.
